title: ce-code-review mode:agent result
description: Machine-checked owner of the minimum mode:agent result shape ce-code-review emits (documented in its finish-review reference), consumed by lfg's step-4 gate via `factory-gates.py validate`. Top-level oneOf: branch 1 is the full result (status complete|degraded) with the documented required fields; branch 2 is the minimal failure shape (status failed|skipped) carrying only status and reason, so a failure result validates and routes by its status instead of degrading as schema-invalid. Strictness policy: the full-result branch and sub-objects the prose fully enumerates (scope, triage_groups entries) carry additionalProperties: false; finding entries, coverage, and requirements_completeness stay open because the prose documents their fields as extensible (e.g. the optional settled_conflict finding field consumers must ignore). Non-required properties cover the rest of the documented minimum shape.

items.description: Open object: merged finding fields plus optional extensions such as settled_conflict; consumers ignore unrecognized fields, so no closed list is pinned.

coverage.description: Open object: coverage notes vary by run (suppression counts, demotions, validator drops, lite-roster note).

verdict_consistency.description: Contradiction strings from the verdict-consistency gate; empty when none, ['unverified — gate unavailable'] when the gate could not run.

requirements_completeness.description: Requirements-completeness report or null; shape intentionally unconstrained.

reason.description: One-sentence reason; present on degraded results.
One-sentence reason the review failed or was skipped.
